<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_VisaAuthority" name="Competent visa authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitApplication" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_VisaAuthority"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkLive" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartParallel" name="Organize in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Organize accommodation through negotiation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Organize a bank account through negotiation"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCycle" name="Apply for or renew visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Another visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card cycle is due (every x months)</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin application cycle"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType" name="Is this a type D visa?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DVisaCompetence" name="Identify the competent Austrian representation using place of residence and centre of interest under Section 8 FPG"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SchengenDestination" name="Determine the Schengen main destination; for equal stays consider length and purpose, and if no main destination can be determined use the country of first entry"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsularDistrict" name="Identify the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResidenceRegistration" name="Legally resident but not registered in that consular district?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ClaimExceptionalCompetence" name="Provide justification and request exceptional competence from that representation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation" name="Use the representation for the applicant's consular district"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DistrictMerge" name="Continue with competent office"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" name="Check the applicable issuing channel: generally a representation abroad, with specified exceptional border-post or permitted-extension channels"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance for location-specific information and any additional document requirements"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" name="Prepare required documents"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check travel document validity, duration, blank pages and issue date"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainPhoto" name="Obtain a compliant 35 x 45 mm passport photo"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned stay"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Provide proof of sufficient means for the stay and return journey"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" name="Gather other requested evidence, such as reservations, invitations, bookings, return ticket or employment proof"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for known refusal grounds, including a residence prohibition or Schengen alert"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsJoin" name="Required documents prepared"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application to the competent authority"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaCycle" name="Application cycle complete"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaStart_Type" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_VisaType"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TypeD" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_DVisaCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Visa type is D</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TypeAC" name="No: category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_SchengenDestination">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Visa category is A or C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DVisa_Channel" sourceRef="Task_DVisaCompetence" targetRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Schengen_District" sourceRef="Task_SchengenDestination" targetRef="Task_ConsularDistrict"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_District_Registration" sourceRef="Task_ConsularDistrict" targetRef="Gateway_ResidenceRegistration"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registration_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ResidenceRegistration" targetRef="Task_ClaimExceptionalCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Applicant is legally resident but not registered in the district</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registration_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ResidenceRegistration" targetRef="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Applicant is registered in the district</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Exceptional_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ClaimExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_District_Merge" sourceRef="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_District_Channel" sourceRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_Contact" sourceRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Documents" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Travel" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Evidence" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Refusal" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_Join" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Travel_Join" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_Join" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Join" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_Join" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evidence_Join" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refusal_Join" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_EndVisa" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="End_VisaCycle"/>

      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_TravelDocument">
        <bpmn:text>Valid in Austria for at least three months beyond the visa duration; at least two empty pages; issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Annotation_TravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Insurance">
        <bpmn:text>Cover of at least 30,000 Euro, valid throughout the planned stay and across the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Insurance" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Annotation_Insurance"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Evidence">
        <bpmn:text>Evidence may vary by location because local standards and coordination with other Schengen representations differ.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Evidence" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Annotation_Evidence"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_IssuingChannel">
        <bpmn:text>Information on representation offices, addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements is available from the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs (BMEIA).</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_IssuingChannel" sourceRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" targetRef="Annotation_IssuingChannel"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WorkJoin" name="Accommodation, bank and visa work complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkLive" name="Current work and living arrangements organized"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="Start_WorkLive" targetRef="Gateway_StartParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkJoin" targetRef="End_WorkLive"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_VisaAuthority" name="Competent visa authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitApplication" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_VisaAuthority"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkLive" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrganizeInParallel" name="Organize in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Organize accommodation through negotiation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Accommodation" name="Accommodation organized"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Organize a bank account through negotiation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankAccount" name="Bank account organized"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCycle" name="Apply for visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card cycle is due (every x months)</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin application cycle"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaCategory" name="Determine visa category"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DVisaCompetence" name="Identify the competent Austrian representation for a type D visa using place of residence and centre of interest under Section 8 FPG"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SchengenDestination" name="Determine the competent Schengen country from the main travel destination; for equal stays consider length and purpose, or use first entry if no main destination can be determined"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsularDistrict" name="Identify the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" name="Can the applicant justify applying to a representation outside the district where they are legally resident but not registered?" default="Flow_UseDistrictRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Provide justification for applying to that representation, which may claim exceptional competence"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JurisdictionMerge" name="Continue with competent representation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" name="Check the applicable issuing channel"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance for information and location-specific requirements"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare additional documents requested by the representation"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" name="Continue document preparation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check the travel document"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainPhoto" name="Obtain a compliant passport photo"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain fully comprehensive travel health insurance"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Provide proof of sufficient means for the stay and return journey"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" name="Gather other requested evidence, such as reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return ticket or proof of gainful employment"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Ensure there are no other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or Schengen alert"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit the visa application to the competent authority"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaCycle" name="Application submitted"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaStart_Category" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_VisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Category_D" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DVisaCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Visa type is D</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Category_AC" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_SchengenDestination">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Visa category is A or C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DVisa_Merge" sourceRef="Task_DVisaCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_JurisdictionMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Schengen_District" sourceRef="Task_SchengenDestination" targetRef="Task_ConsularDistrict"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_District_Exceptional" sourceRef="Task_ConsularDistrict" targetRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Exceptional_Justify" name="Can justify" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Applicant is legally resident but not registered in the district and can justify applying to that representation</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UseDistrictRepresentation" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_JurisdictionMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Justify_Merge" sourceRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_JurisdictionMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Jurisdiction_Channel" sourceRef="Gateway_JurisdictionMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_Contact" sourceRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Additional" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The representation requests additional documents</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalDocuments" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAdditional_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocument_Photo" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Task_ObtainPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_Insurance" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPhoto" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Means" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_Evidence" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evidence_Refusal" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refusal_Submit" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_EndVisa" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="End_VisaCycle"/>

      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_TravelDocument">
        <bpmn:text>The travel document must be valid in Austria for at least three months beyond the visa duration, have at least two empty pages, and have been issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Annotation_TravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Photo">
        <bpmn:text>Portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Photo" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPhoto" targetRef="Annotation_Photo"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Insurance">
        <bpmn:text>Fully comprehensive cover of at least 30,000 Euro, for the planned duration of stay and valid throughout the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Insurance" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Annotation_Insurance"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Evidence">
        <bpmn:text>Evidence may vary by location because local standards and coordination with other Schengen representations differ.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Evidence" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Annotation_Evidence"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_IssuingChannel">
        <bpmn:text>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad. In specific exceptional cases, certain border control posts may issue them; state police headquarters may do so where visa extension is permitted. Information about representation offices, including addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements, is available from BMEIA.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_IssuingChannel" sourceRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" targetRef="Annotation_IssuingChannel"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Accommodation" name="Accommodation organized"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankAccount" name="Bank account organized"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaWork" name="Visa application cycle complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Parallel" sourceRef="Start_WorkLive" targetRef="Gateway_OrganizeInParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_OrganizeInParallel" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_OrganizeInParallel" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_OrganizeInParallel" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_End" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="End_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_End" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="End_BankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_End" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle" targetRef="End_VisaWork"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_VisaAuthority" name="Competent visa authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_VisaApplication" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_VisaAuthority" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkLive" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrganizeSplit" name="Organize in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate a bank account"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCycle" name="Apply for visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further application cycle is due after x months</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin application cycle"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaCategory" name="Is the application for a type D visa?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DVisaCompetence" name="Identify the competent Austrian representation based on place of residence and centre of interest under Section 8 FPG"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineSchengenDestination" name="Determine the main travel destination; for equal stays assess length and purpose"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MainDestination" name="Can the main travel destination be determined?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectMainDestinationCountry" name="Select the country of the main travel destination"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry" name="Select the country of first entry into the Schengen area"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Continue with responsible Schengen country"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ACTerritorialCompetence" name="Identify the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" name="Is the applicant legally resident but not registered in that district?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Provide justification for applying to that representation and request exceptional competence"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation" name="Use the representation for the applicant's consular district"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ACOfficeMerge" name="Continue with category A or C representation"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompetentOfficeMerge" name="Continue with competent representation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" name="Identify the applicable issuing channel: generally a representation abroad, or in specific exceptional cases a border control post or state police headquarters for a permitted extension"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsultBMEIA" name="Consult the BMEIA list of representation offices for addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the competent representation in advance for more information and possible additional document requirements"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepareDocuments" name="Prepare application items in parallel"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check the travel document's validity in Austria, validity period, empty pages and issue date"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainPhoto" name="Obtain a passport photo meeting the 35 x 45 mm portrait-format criteria"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned stay"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Provide proof of sufficient means for the stay and return journey"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" name="Gather other evidence requested by the authorities, including any additional documents requested"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsPrepared" name="Application items prepared"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeApplicationItems" name="Collect and organize the application items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Confirm absence of refusal grounds, including a residence prohibition or a Schengen alert"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit the application to the competent authority" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaCycle" name="Application submitted"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaStart_Category" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_VisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Category_D" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DVisaCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Application is for a type D visa</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Category_AC" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DetermineSchengenDestination">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Application is for a category A or C visa</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DVisa_OfficeMerge" sourceRef="Task_DVisaCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_CompetentOfficeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Decision" sourceRef="Task_DetermineSchengenDestination" targetRef="Gateway_MainDestination"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Known" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectMainDestinationCountry">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The main travel destination can be determined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Unknown" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The main travel destination cannot be determined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainDestination_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SelectMainDestinationCountry" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstEntry_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Territorial" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge" targetRef="Task_ACTerritorialCompetence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Territorial_Exception" sourceRef="Task_ACTerritorialCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Exception_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Applicant is legally resident but not registered in that district</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Exception_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Applicant is not in that exceptional situation</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Justification_ACMerge" sourceRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_ACOfficeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_District_ACMerge" sourceRef="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_ACOfficeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AC_OfficeMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_ACOfficeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CompetentOfficeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Office_Channel" sourceRef="Gateway_CompetentOfficeMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_BMEIA" sourceRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" targetRef="Task_ConsultBMEIA"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BMEIA_Contact" sourceRef="Task_ConsultBMEIA" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Prepare" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocuments" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Travel" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocuments" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocuments" targetRef="Task_ObtainPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocuments" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocuments" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Evidence" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocuments" targetRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_Prepared" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsPrepared"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Travel_Prepared" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsPrepared"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_Prepared" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsPrepared"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Prepared" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsPrepared"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_Prepared" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsPrepared"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evidence_Prepared" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsPrepared"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepared_Organize" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsPrepared" targetRef="Task_OrganizeApplicationItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Organize_CheckGrounds" sourceRef="Task_OrganizeApplicationItems" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Grounds_Submit" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_End" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="End_VisaCycle"/>

      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_TravelDocument">
        <bpmn:text>The travel document must be valid in Austria, exceed the visa duration by at least three months, have at least two empty pages and have been issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Annotation_TravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Insurance">
        <bpmn:text>Insurance must cover the entire planned stay and the entire Schengen area, with cover of 30,000 Euro.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Insurance" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Annotation_Insurance"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Evidence">
        <bpmn:text>Other evidence may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary by location.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Evidence" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Annotation_Evidence"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrganizationJoin" name="Accommodation, bank account and application cycle complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkLive" name="Work and living arrangements organized"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Organize" sourceRef="Start_WorkLive" targetRef="Gateway_OrganizeSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Organize_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_OrganizeSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Organize_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_OrganizeSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Organize_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_OrganizeSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_OrganizationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_OrganizationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_OrganizationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_OrganizationJoin" targetRef="End_WorkLive"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_VisaAuthority" name="Competent visa authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitApplication" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_VisaAuthority"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkLive" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartParallel" name="Organize in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate and reach agreement on accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate and reach agreement on a bank account"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCycle" name="Apply for visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card cycle is due (every x months)</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin visa or card application cycle"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaCategory" name="Is this a type D visa?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DVisaCompetence" name="Identify the competent Austrian representation for a type D visa"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessSchengenDestination" name="Determine the Schengen main travel destination"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationKnown" name="Can the main travel destination be determined?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectMainDestination" name="Select the country of the main travel destination"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstEntry" name="Select the country of first entry into the Schengen area"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Continue with the responsible destination country"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSchengenRepresentation" name="Identify the representation of the responsible Schengen country"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsularDistrict" name="Identify the representation in the applicant's consular district of legal residence"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResidenceRegistration" name="Legally resident but not registered in that consular district?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ClaimExceptionalCompetence" name="Provide justification and request exceptional competence from that representation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation" name="Use the representation for the applicant's consular district"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DistrictMerge" name="Continue with the competent representation"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfficeMerge" name="Continue with the identified competent office"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" name="Identify the applicable visa issuing office"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_FindRepresentationInformation" name="Find the representation's information on the BMEIA website"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance for information"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" name="Prepare required application items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check the travel document"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainPhoto" name="Obtain a compliant passport photo"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Present fully comprehensive travel health insurance"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" name="Gather location-specific evidence requested by the authority"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsJoin" name="Required application items prepared"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeDocuments" name="Collect and organize the application items"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectAdditionalDocuments" name="Collect the additional requested documents"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" name="Continue with application items"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit the visa application to the competent authority"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaCycle" name="Application cycle complete"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaStart_Category" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_VisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Category_D" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DVisaCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Visa type is D</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Category_AC" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_AssessSchengenDestination">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Visa category is A or C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_DestinationKnown" sourceRef="Task_AssessSchengenDestination" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationKnown"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Known" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationKnown" targetRef="Task_SelectMainDestination">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A main travel destination can be determined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Unknown" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationKnown" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstEntry">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A main travel destination cannot be determined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainDestination_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SelectMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstEntry_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstEntry" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Representation" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSchengenRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Schengen_ConsularDistrict" sourceRef="Task_SelectSchengenRepresentation" targetRef="Task_ConsularDistrict"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DVisa_OfficeMerge" sourceRef="Task_DVisaCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_District_Registration" sourceRef="Task_ConsularDistrict" targetRef="Gateway_ResidenceRegistration"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registration_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ResidenceRegistration" targetRef="Task_ClaimExceptionalCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Applicant is legally resident but not registered in that consular district</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registration_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ResidenceRegistration" targetRef="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Applicant is not legally resident but unregistered in that consular district</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Exceptional_DistrictMerge" sourceRef="Task_ClaimExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Use_DistrictMerge" sourceRef="Task_UseDistrictRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_District_OfficeMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_DistrictMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Office_IssuingChannel" sourceRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_BMEIA" sourceRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" targetRef="Task_FindRepresentationInformation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BMEIA_Contact" sourceRef="Task_FindRepresentationInformation" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Documents" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Travel" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Evidence" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Refusal" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_Join" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Travel_Join" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_Join" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Join" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_Join" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evidence_Join" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refusal_Join" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Documents_Organize" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsJoin" targetRef="Task_OrganizeDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Organize_Additional" sourceRef="Task_OrganizeDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_CollectAdditionalDocuments">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The authority requests additional documents</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The authority does not request additional documents</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectAdditional_Merge" sourceRef="Task_CollectAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_EndVisa" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="End_VisaCycle"/>

      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_DestinationRules">
        <bpmn:text>For Schengen visas, the representation of the country of the main travel destination is responsible. If equal time is spent in several countries, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay. If no main destination can be determined, use the country of first entry into the Schengen area.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_DestinationRules" sourceRef="Task_AssessSchengenDestination" targetRef="Annotation_DestinationRules"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_ConsularDistrict">
        <bpmn:text>For category A and C applications, territorial competence falls to the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence. A representation may claim exceptional competence for a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies why the application had to be submitted there.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_ConsularDistrict" sourceRef="Task_ConsularDistrict" targetRef="Annotation_ConsularDistrict"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_DVisaCompetence">
        <bpmn:text>Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation. Under Section 8 FPG, territorial competence is based on the foreign national's place of residence (centre of interest), verifiable by documents such as registration forms, residence permits or visas.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_DVisaCompetence" sourceRef="Task_DVisaCompetence" targetRef="Annotation_DVisaCompetence"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_IssuingChannel">
        <bpmn:text>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad. In specific exceptional cases, they may be issued by certain border control posts or, where visa extension is permitted, by state police headquarters.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_IssuingChannel" sourceRef="Task_CheckIssuingChannel" targetRef="Annotation_IssuingChannel"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_BMEIA">
        <bpmn:text>The BMEIA website lists representation office addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_BMEIA" sourceRef="Task_FindRepresentationInformation" targetRef="Annotation_BMEIA"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_TravelDocument">
        <bpmn:text>The travel document must be valid in Austria, extend at least three months beyond the visa duration, have at least two empty pages and have been issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Annotation_TravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Photo">
        <bpmn:text>A portrait-format passport photo, 35 x 45 mm, must comply with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Photo" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPhoto" targetRef="Annotation_Photo"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Insurance">
        <bpmn:text>Insurance must cover the planned duration of the stay, provide at least 30,000 Euro of cover and be valid throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Insurance" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Annotation_Insurance"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Means">
        <bpmn:text>Proof must cover sufficient means for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Means" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Annotation_Means"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Evidence">
        <bpmn:text>Other evidence may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Evidence can vary by location because local standards and coordination with other Schengen representations differ.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Evidence" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Annotation_Evidence"/>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_RefusalGrounds">
        <bpmn:text>There must be no other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_RefusalGrounds" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Annotation_RefusalGrounds"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WorkJoin" name="Accommodation, bank account and visa work complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkLive" name="Current work and living arrangements organized"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="Start_WorkLive" targetRef="Gateway_StartParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Join" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_WorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkJoin" targetRef="End_WorkLive"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
